defects_fixed.before: Operation filters were not consistently routed and the schema allowed behavior whose names implied side effects.
defects_fixed.after: A strict no-additional-properties schema exposes four read-only operations, routes optional synthetic identifiers, and preserves safe legacy aliases.

defects_fixed.before: The agent could imply eligibility, authorization, clinical interpretation, outreach, scheduling, or record mutation beyond evidence.
defects_fixed.after: Every route uses synthetic-only evidence, explicit uncertainty, no side effects, and a qualified human review gate.

defects_fixed.before: The live model could route the largest evidence-review queue question to the qualitative dashboard, omitting the locked evidence-review wording.
defects_fixed.after: Tool and operation descriptions now map the exact persona intent to gap_analysis, which identifies the largest queue and emits Records requiring evidence review for every measure.

claim_audit.claim: Analyze quality measures and surface high-priority gaps
claim_audit.implementation: Reports aggregate source-evidence queues; reviewers validate measure eligibility and exclusions.

claim_audit.claim: Stratify outreach based on risk, condition severity, and engagement
claim_audit.implementation: Uses operational evidence-review cohorts only, not clinical risk scoring.

claim_audit.claim: Identify common barriers that impacted care completion
claim_audit.implementation: Summarizes synthetic aggregate evidence barriers with explicit limitations.

claim_audit.claim: Launch targeted multi-channel outreach campaigns with real-time progress tracking
claim_audit.implementation: No outreach is launched, no patient is contacted, and no record is changed.

claim_policy: Catalog value claims are qualitative. Exact fields and identifiers are retained only as clearly labeled synthetic evidence.
